query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "the topological trouble with transformers" computer science
rationale: This paper satisfies acceptance criteria (a) and (d) as it investigates the fundamental relationship between topological features and neural network internal representations, which is the core mechanism explored in "The Topological Trouble With Transformers." It provides the necessary empirical baseline and canonical methodology (using neural stitching and CKA to compare representations) for a literature review on how topology influences transformer learning dynamics.
